arxiv-2105-01192.title: Unreasonable Effectiveness of Rule-Based Heuristics in Solving Russian SuperGLUE Tasks
arxiv-2105-01192.creator: Iazykova Tatyana, Bystrova Olga
arxiv-2105-01192.description: Abstract Leaderboards like SuperGLUE are seen as important incentives for active development of NLP, since they provide standard benchmarks for fair comparison of modern language models. They have driven the world’s best engineering teams as well as their resources to collaborate and solve a set of tasks for general language understanding.

arxiv-2301-02069.title: Deep Learning for Breast MRI Style Transfer with Limited Training Data
arxiv-2301-02069.creator: Shixing Cao, Nicholas Konz (ORCID: 0000-0003-0230-1598), James Duncan (ORCID: 0000-0002-5167-9856), Maciej A. Mazurowski (ORCID: 0000-0003-4202-8602)
arxiv-2301-02069.description: Abstract 2021 keywords style transfer, breast MRI, deep learning, machine learning, computer vision Abstract Purpose: In this work we introduce a novel medical image style transfer method, StyleMapper, that can transfer medical scans to an unseen style with access to limited training data.

arxiv-2304-11468.title: Increasing the Scope as You Learn: Adaptive Bayesian Optimization in Nested Subspaces
arxiv-2304-11468.creator: Leonard Papenmeier, Luigi Nardi, Matthias Poloczek
arxiv-2304-11468.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Leonard Papenmeier, Luigi Nardi, Matthias Poloczek. Recent advances have extended the scope of BO ( BO ) to expensive-to-evaluate black-box functions with dozens of dimensions, aspiring to unlock impactful applications, for example, in the life sciences, neural architecture search, and robotics. However, a closer examination reveals that the state-of-the-art methods for HDBO ( HDBO ) suffer from degrading performance as the number of dimensions increases or even risk failure if certain unverifiable assumptions are not met.

arxiv-2308-05766.title: Hypergeometric integrals, hook formulas and Whittaker vectors
arxiv-2308-05766.creator: G. Felder ⋄ , A. Smirnov † , V. Tarasov ∘ , A. Varchenko ⋆
arxiv-2308-05766.description: Abstract . We determine the coefficient of proportionality between two multidimensional hypergeometric integrals. One of them is a solution of the dynamical difference equations associated with a Young diagram and the other is the vertex integral associated with the Young diagram. The coefficient of proportionality is the inverse of the product of weighted hooks of the Young diagram.

arxiv-2309-07822.title: CATfOOD: Counterfactual Augmented Training for Improving Out-of-Domain Performance and Calibration
arxiv-2309-07822.creator: Rachneet Sachdeva, Martin Tutek, Iryna Gurevych Ubiquitous Knowledge Processing Lab (UKP Lab) Department of Computer Science and Hessian Center for AI (hessian.AI) Technical University of Darmstadt www.ukp.tu-darmstadt.de
arxiv-2309-07822.description: Abstract In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities at scale, particularly at generating text conditioned on a prompt. In our work, we investigate the use of LLMs to augment training data of smaller language models (SLMs) with automatically generated counterfactual (CF) instances -- i.e.

arxiv-2310-16804.title: Learning COVID-19 Regional Transmission Using Universal Differential Equations in a SIR model
arxiv-2310-16804.creator: Adrian Rojas-Campos, Lukas Stelz, Pascal Nieters
arxiv-2310-16804.description: Abstract Highly-interconnected societies difficult to model the spread of infectious diseases such as COVID-19. Single-region SIR models fail to account for incoming forces of infection and expanding them to a large number of interacting regions involves many assumptions that do not hold in the real world.

arxiv-2412-09052.title: GREAT: Grassmannian REcursive Algorithm for Tracking & Online System Identification
arxiv-2412-09052.creator: András Sasfi, Alberto Padoan, Ivan Markovsky, Florian Dörfler
arxiv-2412-09052.description: Abstract This paper introduces an online approach for identifying time-varying subspaces defined by linear dynamical systems. The approach of representing linear systems by non-parametric subspace models has received significant interest in the field of data-driven control recently. This system representation enables us to provide rigorous guarantees for linear time-varying systems, which are difficult to obtain for parametric system models.

arxiv-2503-24274.title: Implementation and readout of maximally entangled two-qubit gates quantum circuits in a superconducting quantum processor
arxiv-2503-24274.creator: V. Stasino, P. Mastrovito, C. Cosenza, A. Levochkina, M. Esposito, D. Montemurro, G.P. Pepe, A. Bruno, F. Tafuri, D. Massarotti, H.G. Ahmad
arxiv-2503-24274.description: Abstract Besides noticeable challenges in implementing low-error single- and two-qubit quantum gates in superconducting quantum processors, the readout technique and analysis are a key factor in determining the efficiency and performance of quantum processors. Being able to efficiently implement quantum algorithms involving entangling gates and asses their output is mandatory for quantum utility.

arxiv-2506-12065.title: Segre Characteristic Equivalence
arxiv-2506-12065.description: Abstract SEGRE CHARACTERISTIC EQUIVALENCE Jessie Pitsillides August 8, 2026 Given only the dimension, n , of a square matrix A\in M(n,\mathbb{C}) , how many Segre Characteristic equivalent matrices are there? Jordan Normal Form Theorem states that any linear operator over \mathbb{C} is similar to a matrix in Jordan Normal Form [ Axler, 2015 , p. 324] .

arxiv-2510-03435.title: Holomorphic, rational Lax pairs of a q q -discrete Painlevé VI equation
arxiv-2510-03435.creator: Robert Conte 1. Université Paris-Saclay, ENS Paris-Saclay, CNRSCentre Borelli, F-91190 Gif-sur-Yvette, France2. Department of mathematics, The University of Hong Kong,Pokfulam, Hong Kong3. Centre de Recherches mathématiques, Université de Montréal,C.P. 6128, Succ. Centre-ville, Montréal H3C 3J7, Qué
arxiv-2510-03435.description: Abstract We build several matrix Lax pairs of q − P VI {\rm q-P_{\rm VI}} valid even when the two eigenvalues of the residue of the monodromy matrix at infinity are equal. Their elements are rational functions of the dependent variables.

arxiv-2510-22643.title: Enhancing Graph Classification Robustness with Singular Pooling
arxiv-2510-22643.creator: Sofiane Ennadir, Oleg Smirnov, Yassine Abbahaddou, Lele Cao, Johannes F. Lutzeyer
arxiv-2510-22643.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have achieved strong performance across a range of graph representation learning tasks, yet their adversarial robustness in graph classification remains underexplored compared to node classification. While most existing defenses focus on the message-passing component, this work investigates the overlooked role of pooling operations in shaping robustness.

pmc-11612230.title: COVID-19 clinical phenotypes in vaccinated and nonvaccinated solid organ transplant recipients: a multicenter validation study
pmc-11612230.creator: Carmen Infante-Domínguez, Sonsoles Salto-Alejandre, Rocío Álvarez-Marín, Nuria Sabé, Antonio Ramos-Martínez, Asunción Moreno, Kamilla Ferreira de Moraes, Zaira R Palacios-Baena, Patricia Muñoz, Mario Fernández-Ruiz, Marino Blanes, Carmen Fariñas, Elisa Vidal, Esperanza Merino de Lucas, Márcia Halper
pmc-11612230.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Clinical phenotypes of COVID-19, associated with mortality risk, have been identified in the general population. The present study assesses their applicability in solid organ transplant recipients (SOTR) hospital-admitted by COVID-19. In a cohort of 488 SOTR, nonvaccinated (n = 394) and vaccinated (n = 94) against SARS-CoV-2, we evaluated 16 demographic, clinical, analytical, and radiological variables to identify the clinical phenotypes A, B, and C.

pmc-12491560.title: Lightweight Unet with depthwise separable convolution for skin lesion segmentation
pmc-12491560.creator: Yong Li, Bosheng Hu, Xia Wang, Kun Liu
pmc-12491560.description: Accurate segmentation of skin lesions is crucial for the early diagnosis of skin diseases, as clear lesion boundaries facilitate the comprehensive extraction of lesion features. However, in practical applications, the contours or boundaries of lesion areas in medical images often appear blurred and lose detail due to factors such as lighting conditions, imaging equipment, skin color differences, and physician experience.

pmc-12527368.title: Social and Environmental Determinants of Childhood Stunting in Indonesia: National Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-12527368.creator: Yuni Sufyanti Arief, Fildzah Cindra Yunita, Ferry Efendi, Fadhaa Aditya Kautsar Murti, Rifky Octavia Pradipta, Lisa McKenna
pmc-12527368.description: BackgroundThe cause-effect of stunting is known as a complex factor, including family, environmental, social, and cultural factors, in stunting among children. Yet, the latest updated associated factors emphasizing on social and environmental factors are still limited.ObjectiveThis study aimed to analyze the latest evidence on the factors associated with stunting, with a particular focus on various factors.

pmc-12529115.title: Enhanced Protein Precipitation with Ammonia Enables Rapid, Universal Extraction of Oligonucleotides for Bioanalysis
pmc-12529115.creator: Afrand Kamali, Juili D. Shelke, Ethan J. Sanford, Michael M. Hayashi, Natthamon Chaisakhon, Robert V. Kolakowski, Sanyogitta Puri, Guangnong Zhang
pmc-12529115.description: Discovery, characterization, and development of oligonucleotides (ONTs) require a universal method that is low-cost and efficient, without requiring extensive method development for each new test article. Protein precipitation using organic solvents meets these criteria for small molecules but has historically failed for ONTs due to poor recovery arising from their tendency to coprecipitate with proteins.

pmc-12584468.title: Best microbiological practice recommendations for the diagnosis of peri-prosthetic joint infections: the CRIOGO bacteriology reference center network
pmc-12584468.creator: Pascale Bémer, Chloé Plouzeau-Jayle, Carole Lemarié, Didier Tande, Anne Gougeon-Jolivet, Rachel Chenouard, Claudie Lamoureux, Sophie Reissier, Louise Ruffier d’Epenoux, Laura Chaufour, Marie-Frédérique Lartigue, Stéphane Corvec
pmc-12584468.description: Diagnosis of prosthetic Joint Infections (PJI) remains challenging at the microbiological level. Despite the implementation and adoption of new methods, an heterogeniety of microbiological practices is still observed. These CRIOGO recommendations (Centre de Référence des Infections Ostéo-articulaires du Grand Ouest) aim to set out some basic principles for the diagnosis of PJI in microbiology laboratories.

pmc-12648511.title: Vaccine research in cognitive impairment and dementia: a bibliometric analysis and future outlook (2000–2025)
pmc-12648511.creator: Zhongli Wang, Xiaojia Xue, Hua Zhang, Jipeng Liu, Shoujie Dai, Haiping Duan, Shixue Li
pmc-12648511.description: BackgroundVaccine research has shifted from a purely anti-infective tool to a promising therapeutic and preventive strategy against cognitive impairment (CI) and dementia. Yet the knowledge domain linking vaccine to neurodegeneration has never been systematically mapped.MethodsWe retrieved English-language articles and reviews on vaccine and CI/dementia in Web of Science and PubMed (2000–2025).

pmc-12691126.title: Imbalance in MICOS Proteins in Rat Liver Mitochondria in an Induced Hyperthyroidism Model
pmc-12691126.creator: Natalya Venediktova, Ilya Solomadin, Anna Nikiforova, Tatiana Bessonova, Anna Maria Ghelli
pmc-12691126.description: This study investigated rearrangements in the cristae structure and the possible relationship between these changes and the MICOS levels in the liver mitochondria of rats with experimentally induced hyperthyroidism. In hyperthyroid rats (HRs), the number, area, and perimeter of mitochondria were increased, and organelles of a worm-shaped, branched, highly elongated, or spherical shape appeared.

pmc-12712612.title: Utility of the cellular energy allocation model for assessing food limitation stress in freshwater mussels
pmc-12712612.creator: Kaelyn J Fogelman, Andrea K Darracq, Monte A McGregor, James A Stoeckel, Wendell R Haag
pmc-12712612.description: Freshwater mussel populations are declining worldwide, but the causes and mechanisms of these declines are poorly understood. Biomarkers that reflect the health or fitness of individual mussels are needed for understanding causes of mussel declines, but existing approaches each have weaknesses.

pmc-13367640.title: Treatment Sequencing in Platinum-Resistant Epithelial Ovarian Cancer After MIRASOL, KEYNOTE-B96, and ROSELLA
pmc-13367640.creator: Yuling Liu, Meng Xu, Jiao Ma, Yu Zhu, Meiling Gao
pmc-13367640.description: Platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian cancer has long been managed as a clinically defined state with limited therapeutic differentiation. This narrative review aims to clarify how recent Phase III evidence should inform treatment allocation and sequencing after the MIRASOL, KEYNOTE-B96, and ROSELLA trials.

pmc-13478779.title: Case Report: Surgical correction of Lenke 1 adolescent idiopathic scoliosis with a single rod instrumentation
pmc-13478779.creator: Francesco Vommaro, Giovanni Ciani, Chiara Cini, Bruna Maccaferri, Alessandro Gasbarrini
pmc-13478779.description: Introduction: Posterior spinal fusion is the current gold standard for severe adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS). Less invasive techniques have recently gained interest. Case presentation: A 13-year-old female with Lenke 1 AIS (65° thoracic curve) underwent unilateral pedicle screw fixation and posterior fusion via a minimally invasive approach. Surgery lasted 100 min with 200 mL blood loss.
